description:
Problem
BO channel pages contain fixed light-theme colors, so cards remain white and black text/icons lose contrast on dark surfaces. The user specifically reports Mattermost is difficult to identify in dark mode. Read-only Serena audit established the evidence below; browser verification remains required.

Scope
1. Shared components:
- lib/zaq_web/components/design_system/channel_connector_card.ex:43: replace fixed white surface, black text/borders, icon colors and enabled/disabled badge colors with design-system styling. Preserve all slots, IDs, events, selection and enable/edit behavior. Used by retrieval, SMTP, IMAP and Web Widget.
- lib/zaq_web/components/channel_capabilities.ex:19: theme trigger, modal body/title, supported/unsupported states and Close control.
- lib/zaq_web/components/connect_credential_form.ex:34: theme labels, inputs/selects, readonly/disabled states and actions.
- lib/zaq_web/components/channel_icons.ex:140,147: Mattermost SVG paths have fixed #1D325C; webhook at :171 has fixed #000000. Provide theme-aware monochrome icon colors or appropriate light variants in dark mode. Audit every provider icon on its actual backgrounds, including small category previews. Preserve multicolor brand identity; do not globally invert logos.

2. Page-specific markup:
- lib/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/channels_index_live.html.heex: category/provider cards pass bg-white and black borders to CardShell (29,92,223); audit inline accents, actions and ingress-status modal.
- lib/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/channels_live.html.heex: empty states, selectors, configuration/status panels, team/channel lists, message composer, thread/reply display, errors, config and credential modal bodies, OAuth/ingress status content, Clear Channel and Test Connection dialogs.
- lib/zaq_web/live/bo/data_sources/provider_live.html.heex: summary/connector cards, empty state, controls and modal content, including shared credential form.
- lib/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/notification_email_live.html.heex: SMTP/IMAP navigation cards and text.
- lib/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/notification_smtp_live.html.heex and notification_imap_live.html.heex: settings panels/headers, labels, inputs, toggles, actions, feedback and test-message UI.
- lib/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/notification_logs_live.html.heex: search, table/rows, status indicators, detail modal and content panels.
- Web Widget uses many DS components already, but inherits ChannelConnectorCard and ChannelCapabilities defects. Verify shared changes there. Check channel history for regressions; avoid migrating already-correct DS markup unnecessarily.

Implementation guidance
Use Serena for source navigation (explicit user preference); follow docs/agent-tools.md and Context Mode for aggregate output. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, DESIGN.md, docs/bo-components.md, docs/code-quality.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/testing-approach.md, plus applicable design/design-migrate skills and Storybook contracts before affected work. Use existing semantic --zaq-* tokens and reusable DS components. Inspect actual cascade before claiming a hardcoded class wins. Reuse BOModal shells; theme caller-owned bodies. Avoid broad unrelated refactors, backend changes and duplicated components. Break implementation into durable child tasks/dependencies if required by workflow before coding.

Action reuse: not applicable — styling/icon contrast changes only; no executable operation, authorization, dispatch or persistence contract changes.

Acceptance and validation
- All scoped routes, cards, controls, empty/loading/error states and dialogs are readable in light and dark modes, including after LiveView updates.
- Mattermost and webhook are clearly identifiable on real dark backgrounds at normal and small preview sizes; inspect all other provider logos too.
- Semantic surfaces, text, borders, feedback, focus, hover, selected and disabled states adapt via data-zaq-theme, preserving light-mode appearance and brand identity. Meet DESIGN.md contrast requirements.
- Preserve routes, form submission/validation, connector lifecycle, IDs/events, authorization and modal behavior.
- Update relevant Storybook coverage and provide browser screenshots/evidence in both themes.
- Run mix q and focused component/LiveView tests, required existing E2E per workflow, and final mix precommit at the final gate. Obtain explicit approval before changing existing test behavior; follow human UX/E2E authoring gates where applicable. Record blockers rather than claiming unperformed verification.


Implementation status
Implemented and validated in the working tree. Final mix precommit, mix q, focused tests, and existing E2E pass; details and evidence are in the issue comments. Awaiting review and authorized landing. No commit or push performed.

comments.text: Plan dependency audit: zaq-twk.1 -> zaq-twk.2 -> zaq-twk.3, an acyclic chain with only shared components initially ready. User explicitly authorizes implementation and validation; this supersedes migration-table reapproval for the requested scope. Migration table: cards white/black -> existing DS raised/card/border styles; text and feedback -> semantic text/surface/border roles; controls/actions -> existing DS controls/buttons; monochrome icons -> semantic icon color while multicolor fills remain. Context Mode execution works; automatic hooks are absent, so use execution tools explicitly without claiming automatic session capture. Existing E2E execution and manual browser inspection suffice for this presentation-only correction; no new feature journeys planned.

Implementation and validation complete in the working tree; no commits or pushes.

Changes: theme-aware shared connector cards, capabilities and credential forms; scoped channel hub/configuration, data-source provider, email, SMTP/IMAP and notification-log pages; BOModal shells for remaining custom dialogs; semantic channel row/selection/Markdown styles; opt-in native-select chevrons; Mattermost/webhook monochrome fills. Preserve multicolor logos, field/ID/event/route/authorization contracts. Four Storybook previews updated. Existing color assertions/selectors updated only under the two recorded user approvals.

Validation: final mix q passed; focused regression selection 351 passed; supplemental converter and final SMTP/IMAP/log tests 174 passed. Full existing E2E reporter completed 590 passed, 3 existing skips; final-build channel specs passed 9/9 across three browsers. Full Storybook checks passed 110/110. Final mix precommit passed: Result: 12360 passed (48 doctests, 359 properties, 11953 tests), 1 skipped, 167 excluded

Browser evidence: 50 real-page/theme/dialog observations plus shared Storybook previews; no JS errors or custom-text contrast failures (scalar audit excludes gradient-painted DS primary controls and disabled controls). Mattermost and webhook contrast is 7.79:1 normal / 6.32:1 preview in light mode; 8.55:1 normal / 6.66:1 preview in dark mode. Gallery: /tmp/zaq-twk-evidence/index.html; measurements beside it.

Environment: initial precommit had exactly five converter failures from missing local Python dependencies. Reused the populated main-checkout virtual environment locally; the five cases and final gate pass. No software installation or shared environment modification. Context Mode long-call RPC timeout was worked around using persisted execution logs/results; the full E2E reporter completion was verified.

Action reuse remains not applicable: presentation-only changes. No new feature journeys were authored; existing E2E and browser inspection cover this correction. Numerical coverage handoff remains post-PR-review per workflow; no PR review/merge requested. No validation blockers remain. Parent issue stays in progress pending review and authorized landing.

Hover regression fixed and validated in the working tree.

Root cause: the decorative absolute hover layers became opaque accent surfaces and painted above unpositioned card titles/descriptions/footer content. Removed these layers from the hub/provider cards and equivalent email navigation cards; retain existing DS card hover borders/shadows and all routes, IDs, events and logos. No new production CSS or backend changes.

Red/green regression: the new focused browser check failed in both themes before the fix. It now passes with the existing channel checks across Firefox, WebKit and Chromium (15/15). It checks hovered descriptions on the hub, retrieval providers, data-source providers and email navigation. No existing test assertions were changed; this is focused regression coverage, not new feature-journey authoring.

Validation: mix q passed; 34 focused LiveView/CardShell checks passed; final mix precommit passed: Result: 10882 passed (17 doctests, 257 properties, 10608 tests), 1 skipped, 159 excluded

Browser inspection confirms exposed text in all eight hovered route/theme samples. Description contrast is 7.79:1 in light mode and 8.55:1 in dark mode. Before/after gallery: /tmp/zaq-twk-evidence/hover.html; measurements: /tmp/zaq-twk-evidence/hover-observations.json.

Action reuse: not applicable, presentation-only correction. No remaining validation blockers. Changes remain uncommitted; nothing pushed. Parent zaq-twk remains in progress pending review/authorized landing.

Spacing follow-up zaq-twk.5 complete: consistent 16px inset between provider icon row and titles in channels_index_live.html.heex. mix q and diff checks passed; no tests added/run as requested. Latest change remains uncommitted.

User explicitly authorized commit, push and PR creation on jat10/zaq. Fork main is four commits behind this checkout; user clarified that this must be a stacked PR with base feat/channel-file-settings. Preserve current fix/channel-dark-theme branch and publish only its theme/card correction diff against that parent. Final precommit gate is running on the completed spacing revision before commit/push.

Committed and pushed 43012548436533e2177e2ba370d92adb7cb9487a on fix/channel-dark-theme. Created stacked PR https://github.com/jat10/zaq/pull/17 using gh, with base feat/channel-file-settings (parent PR #16), as explicitly requested by the user. Verified the PR contains exactly one new commit and the 23 reviewed files, plus the change summary, Action reuse assessment and validation body. Fresh final mix precommit passed 10,880 checks (1 existing skip, 159 exclusions); commit qf/message hooks and push formatting hook passed. Working tree is clean. Awaiting PR review/merge; no merge performed.

title: [zaq-twk] Restore design-system dark theme across BO channel pages and icons
